# WEEKLY ATOMIC SHOP UPDATE: FEBRUARY 28TH TO MARCH 7TH

Read on if you want to find out what new and great items are currently available in the Atomic Shop, including the free items of the week.

#### FREE ITEMS

![](https://images.ctfassets.net/rporu91m20dc/6ENzdIcV3vxO6VajEde93q/3fc408f4f55912ce7d680afb9fa5533e/f76_Fasnachtler_1920x870.png)

If you want to represent Vault-Tec, you should definitely use paintwork and skins approved by Vault-Tec. So this week, the official Vault-Tec flamethrower paint job is available for free to all Fallout 76 players. Grab them by **7. March**.

Fallout 1st members have until **7. March** pick up a free carnival outfit for carnival and the ammunition storage box.
